instruction: Match the following VERBS and NOUNS with their definitions.

items.questionText: distort
items.correctAnswer: to change the appearance, sound, or shape of something so that it is strange or unclear

items.questionText: fade
disguise
items.correctAnswer: to change someone’s appearance so that people cannot recognize them

items.questionText: trap
items.correctAnswer: to trick someone so that you make them do or say something that they did not intend to

items.questionText: worship
items.correctAnswer: to admire and love someone very much

items.questionText: speculate
items.correctAnswer: to think or talk about the possible causes or effects of something without knowing all the facts or details

items.questionText: deviate
items.correctAnswer: to do something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving; to go in a different direction

instruction: Fill in the gaps with appropriate words from the box. You can change the form of the verbs according to the tense.

items.questionText: The poll showed that over 40 percent of Americans ____________ on a weekly basis in their neighborhood churches.
The journalist ____________   himself as a waiter in order to get into the celebrity party and nobody found it out.
Critics said the speaker not only ____________   the facts but unfairly criticized one of the city's great success stories.
Officials refused to ____________ on the cause of the crash. They had to listen to the witnesses to get more details about the accident.
Our childhood memories ____________ as time goes by. Talking about the old times and looking at the photographs help us remember our childhood.
The plane had to ____________ from its normal flight path due to severe weather conditions.

instruction: Match the following ADJECTIVES with their definitions.

items.questionText: anonymous
concrete
items.correctAnswer: clear and certain, or real and existing in a form that can be seen or felt

items.questionText: accessible
items.correctAnswer: able to be reached easily; easy to talk to

items.questionText: patriotic
items.correctAnswer: having or expressing a great love of your country

items.questionText: urban
cynical
items.correctAnswer: not trusting or respecting the goodness of other people and their actions, but believing that people are interested only in themselves

instruction: Collocate the adjectives above with the following words.

items.questionText: benefactor / donor / caller / letter / gift
islands / public areas / buildings / staff / teachers / managers / to users
evidence / proposal / argument
attempt / view of life / propaganda / writer / journalist / politician
songs / activities / duties / people
areas / population / growth / planning / unemployment / development projects

instruction: Match the following NOUNS with their definitions.

items.questionText: breadth
items.correctAnswer: the distance from one side of something to the other

items.questionText: layer
items.correctAnswer: a level of material that is different from the material above or below it, or a thin sheet of a substance

items.questionText: commerce
items.correctAnswer: the buying and selling of goods and services; trade

items.questionText: rigour
items.correctAnswer: great care and thoroughness in making sure that something is correct

items.questionText: prejudice
items.correctAnswer: an unreasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval

items.questionText: sacrifice
items.correctAnswer: the act of giving up something that is valuable to you in order to help someone else

items.questionText: discrimination
items.correctAnswer: the unfair or prejudicial treatment of individuals or groups based on characteristics such as race, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or other personal attributes.

items.questionText: Rural
items.correctAnswer: areas that are located outside of cities and towns, typically characterized by open countryside, lower population density, and less developed infrastructure.

instruction: PART 6. The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the sentences. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: 1. Half of the people questioned said they were opposed to military __________________ in the civil war. (INTERVENE)
